confirmed_blocking.summary: Quickstart promises a throwaway home but XDG_CONFIG_HOME expands from the real $HOME, so install/uninstall act on the user's real OpenCode config and repoint then remove the user's real factory links.
confirmed_blocking.evidence: `export HOME="$(mktemp -d)" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$HOME/.config"` expands all words before export runs; verified in bash and zsh. ENG-26.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Use separate commands: `export HOME="$(mktemp -d)"` then `export XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$HOME/.config"`; unset inherited FACTORY_HOME/harness-home overrides first.
